text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal captures the right procedure (caniuse lookup, MDN page, drafted reply with the right subject and body), but it ends with \"Send\" when the true workflow discards the draft and closes the MDN tab, it omits the \"not supported yet\" case, and it splits customer into recipient_email and recipient_name (the true email is {customer}@example.com) and uses inconsistent {name} and {recipient_name} placeholders, so an automation would be partly ambiguous and risky."}

data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure (caniuse lookup, MDN page, drafted reply with the right subject and body), but it ends with "Send" when the true workflow discards the draft and closes the MDN tab, it omits the "not supported yet" case, and it splits customer into recipient_email and recipient_name (the true email is {customer}@example.com) and uses inconsistent {name} and {recipient_name} placeholders, so an automation would be partly ambiguous and risky.
